title: A failed lifecycle-state history index build is retried in the next read scope
description: A failed lifecycle-state history index build is retried in the next read scope
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-140 builds one lifecycle-state history index per command and falls back per archive only when it cannot be built; a failed build was remembered per thread, so every later read scope at the same HEAD skipped the build (#982)
acceptance_criteria: after one failed lifecycle-state history build, the same read scope does not retry it and still falls back per archive, and the next read scope at the same HEAD builds the index; a built index is still reused across scopes at the same HEAD; verdicts are unchanged
